description: Jordan has a spare room in the apartment and must decide whether to sublet it to an interested acquaintance, then finalize the rent, deposit, term, household quiet arrangement, and trust checks with the people gathered for the discussion.

shared_context.S1: Jordan has one furnished spare room available in the apartment.
shared_context.S2: The room is available for an informal sublet beginning in August.
shared_context.S3: Jordan makes the final decision about the sublet and its verbal terms.
shared_context.S4: At this apartment's regular house-arrangement check-in, Jordan conducts a required round in this order: Elena states her exact proposed terms, Marcus states any competing offer and his exact comparison terms, Priya states every household constraint, and Sam states every relevant reference detail. Jordan does not decide until each person has answered their assigned question aloud.
shared_context.S5: Jordan's usual verbal-sublet checklist records the selected applicant's exact rent, deposit, term, and move-in date, records any competing offer used for comparison, and turns each accepted household or conduct requirement into an explicit commitment before the discussion closes.

PF1.text: Elena's concrete proposal is $725 per month, a $300 deposit, a six-month term, and move-in on August 1st; she has not yet stated these exact terms to Jordan.

PF2.text: Marcus has another interested-room offer for exactly $760 per month with a four-month term and August 15th move-in; he learned this from the other leaseholder yesterday and has not shared it with the group.

PF3.text: Priya works night shifts on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday and requires quiet in the apartment from 21:00 until 07:00 on those nights.

PF4.text: Sam was Elena's former landlord and confirms that Elena paid on time throughout her prior lease and did not smoke inside; Sam has not previously given Jordan this reference.

acceptance_conditions: The room must be sublet to Elena.
The monthly rent must be exactly $725.
The term must be exactly six months beginning August 1st.
The settlement must record Marcus's exactly $760 alternative as the comparison offer.
The quiet arrangement must cover Monday, Wednesday, and Friday nights from 21:00 until 07:00.
A quiet-hours commitment for all residents must be logged.
A reference check for Elena must be completed.
A no-smoking commitment for Elena must be logged.
Jordan must cite Marcus's alternative when justifying the final arrangement.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'quiet_hours' and c['target'] == 'all_residents' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'no_smoking' and c['target'] == 'Elena' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Elena's exact proposal changes the settlement to Elena at $725 with a $300 deposit, a six-month term, and an August 1st move-in instead of unspecified sublet terms.
Marcus's information changes the comparison entry to an exact $760 monthly alternative and gives Jordan the specific benchmark to cite when choosing Elena's lower offer.
Priya's work schedule changes the quiet arrangement to Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 21:00 to 07:00 and requires the corresponding all-residents commitment.
Sam's former-landlord confirmation changes the trust step to a completed reference check and supports an explicit no-smoking commitment for Elena.
